title: Greenworks’ MaximusZ electric riding mower has five motors and a few compromises
summary: The 80-volt architecture within the MaximusZ mower here is the company’s latest, with Greenworks offering various packs of various sizes. Squint, though, and you can see the current state of charge, maximum mower speed, maximum blade speed, and total runtime.
